content.text:
Rain's likely all day (90%), so the indoor one fits best: Indoor open play gym at Riverbend Community Centre runs Saturdays 9 a.m. to noon, $6 per child, and it suits a 2-year-old. That's per their program page, so I haven't confirmed it myself. [link-187000]

If the weather clears, Toddler nature walk (outdoor trail) is Saturdays at 10 a.m. and free, per Cedar Park Conservancy's events page. [link-0b6114]
